entities.name: Disseminated Mycobacterium avium complex infection
observations: In advanced AIDS with CD4 <50/mm³, AFB-positive blood cultures and systemic illness are characteristic of disseminated MAC.

entities.name: MAC regimen: macrolide plus ethambutol
observations: Preferred initial therapy for disseminated MAC is a macrolide (azithromycin or clarithromycin) plus ethambutol; rifabutin may be added for severe disease but does not replace ethambutol.
